Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:10:1.hebrew: בחד יומא - והעידו על שלש נגיחות של ג' ימים:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:10:1.english: On one day - And they testified about three gorings on three [separate] days.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:10:2.hebrew: אי אמרת - לא בעינן ג' ימים אלא לייעודי תורא ולמעוטי קירב נגיחותיו, הא מייעד, דריחק בנגיחות:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:10:2.english: If you say - [that] we require three days only to render the ox forewarned and to exclude [a case where] it brought its gorings close together, [then] this [ox] is rendered forewarned, since it spaced out the gorings.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:10:3.hebrew: השתא הוא דקמסהדו בי - כל שלשתן הכיתות באו ביום אחד, והתורה אמרה שלשה ימים:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:10:3.english: It is [only] now that they are testifying against me - All three groups [of witnesses] came on one day, whereas the Torah said three days.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:11:1.hebrew: והועד בבעליו - ואין עדות אלא בב"ד:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:11:1.english: And it has been testified to its owner - And testimony is only [valid] in a court.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:12:1.hebrew: הרי כאן ג' עדיות - שאם בטלה אחת מהם, לא בטלו השתים ומשלם עליהם חצי נזק. ואם לא בטלה, הרי הוא מועד:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:12:1.english: There are three testimonies here - For if one of them is invalidated, the [other] two are not invalidated, and he pays half-damages for them. And if it is not invalidated, [the ox] is [established as] a forewarned [ox] (mu'ad).

Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:12:2.hebrew: והן עדות אחת להזמה - שהרי על ידי שלשתן הוא מועד. הלכך, עדות אחת הן לכך שאם נמצאת כת ראשונה זוממת, הוא פטור מלשלם על הנגיחה שלישית אלא חצי נזק:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:12:2.english: And they are one testimony with regard to rendering [them] conspiring witnesses - For through all three of them [the ox] is rendered forewarned. Therefore, they are one testimony in this respect, that if the first group [of witnesses] is found to be conspiring, [the owner] is exempt from paying [anything] for the third goring except half-damages.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:12:3.english: And they - [This refers to] the conspiring [witnesses].

Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:13:1.hebrew: פטורין - מתשלומי נגיחה שלישית. ואע"פ שהן היו גורמים לו לשלם עליה נ"ש, פטורין, שאין העדים משלמין ממון עד שיזומו כולן:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:13:1.english: Exempt - From paying for the third goring. And even though they were causing him to pay full damage for it, they are exempt, because witnesses do not pay money unless all of them are proven to be conspiring witnesses.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:14:1.hebrew: כולן חייבין - לשלם הח"נ של העדאת נגיחה שלישית בין כולן, וצד תמות משלמים שני עדים האחרונים שהעידו עליה:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:14:1.english: All of them are liable - to pay the half-damage of the forewarning testimony of the third goring among all of them, and the tam portion is paid by the last two witnesses who testified about it.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:15:1.hebrew: אי אמרת לייעוד תורא - בעינן ג' ימים, אבל גברא ביום אחד מייעד, מצי לאוקמא כשבאו כולן ביום אחד, שהביאן ניזק שלישי להעיד על ג' נגיחות של ג' ימים. ומשום הכי שייכי קמאי בצד העדאה, שרגלים לדבר דלשוייה מועד אתו, דלא מצו למימר: אנן לחיובי פלגא נזקא אתינן מקמייתא ולא לשוייה מועד, דודאי הני ידעי בהני, שהרי בעל נגיחה שלישית הביאן, ומה לו ולנגיחות הראשונות? אלא כדי לייעדו, ובהדי הדדי אתו:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:15:1.english: If you say to forewarn the ox - [meaning that] we require three days, whereas the owner is forewarned in one day, [one] can establish [the baraita] as referring to when they all came on one day, [where] the third injured party brought them to testify about three gorings on three days. And therefore, the first [witnesses] are connected to the aspect of forewarning, for there is a basis [to conclude] that they came to render it forewarned, as they cannot say, "We came to obligate [the owner for] half-damages for the first [gorings], and not to render it forewarned," since these certainly knew of those, for the victim of the third goring brought them — and what does he have to do with the first gorings? Rather, [he brought them] in order to render it forewarned, and they came together.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:1:1.english: [If] it performed its gorings at intervals - [Over] three days.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:1:2.english: Liable - As it is written: "yesterday [and] the day before" [Exodus 21:29].

Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:1:3.hebrew: ריחקה ראיותיה - ג' ראיות בג' ימים, טמאה ז' ימים, כדכתיב: "כי יזוב זוב דמה ימים רבים", ודרשינן (בת"כ פ' מצורע): "ימים" — שנים, "רבים" — שלשה:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:1:3.english: Her sightings occurred at intervals - [If she had] three sightings on three [consecutive] days, she is impure [for] seven days, as it is written: "when a discharge of her blood flows for many days," and we expound (in Torat Kohanim, Parashat Metzora): "days" [means] two, "many" [means] three.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:1:4.hebrew: קירבה ראיותיה - ביום אחד, טהורה מטומאת שבעה, אלא שומרת יום כנגד יום:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:1:4.english: She brought her sightings close together - [i.e.,] on one day; she is pure from the seven-day impurity, rather she observes a day for a day.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:2:1.hebrew: הרי הוא אומר וזאת כו' - ומשום גזירת הכתוב הוא דלא דרשינן ק"ו:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:2:1.english: Behold, it says, “And this...” - And it is because of a scriptural decree that we do not expound an a fortiori inference.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:2:2.hebrew: הזב בראיות - דכתיב בהאי קרא זוב תלתא זימני, וכתיב טומאתו היא, דמשמע בהנך ג' הוי טמא; וכתיב זאת, דמשמע אין לך אלא מה שכתוב בו — זב בראיות, ולא זבה בראיות:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:2:2.english: The zav with sightings - For in this verse, “discharge” [zov] is written three times, and it is written “it is his impurity,” which implies [that] with those three [sightings] he is impure. And it is written “this,” which implies [that] you have only what is written in it — a zav [is rendered impure] by sightings, and not a zava by sightings.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:5:1.hebrew: קאי בראיות - האי וזאת גבי ראיות כתיב, וממעט ראיות לזבה:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:5:1.english: [It] deals with sightings - This [word,] "and this," is written regarding sightings, and [therefore] it excludes sightings for a zavah.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:5:2.english: It excludes days - [This is asked] in astonishment [as a rhetorical question].

Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:6:1.hebrew: אלא לחזרה - שאם חזר לאחר העדאתו שלשה ימים, שראה שוורים ולא נגח, חזר לתמותו:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:6:1.english: Only with regard to reversal - For if it reverted after its forewarning [for] three days — [namely,] that it saw oxen and did not gore — it returns to its innocuous status.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:8:1.english: In accordance with Rabbi Yehuda - of the Mishnah.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:8:2.english: His reasoning is with him - His reasons and his proofs are with him.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:9:1.english: To render the ox forewarned - And to exclude [a case] where it gored on one day.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 24a:9:2.english: Or to forewarn the man - We require three days to forewarn the owner of the ox.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 24a:10:1.hebrew: תלתא כיתי עדים - לאו דוקא, דהוא הדין כת אחת:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 24a:10:1.english: Three groups of witnesses - Not specifically [three groups], for the same law applies to a single group:

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 24a:10:2.hebrew: השתא הוא דקמסהדי בי - תימה לר"י, דמ"מ קנס לא הוי אפי' למ"ד (לעיל בבא קמא דף טו.) פלגא נזקא קנסא, דמכי נגח שלש נגיחות יצא מחזקת שימור. ונראה לתרץ דאין חצי נזק חלוק; כיון דהוי קנס בחד דוכתא, הוי קנס בכל דוכתי, כדאשכחן גבי שלשים של עבד, דאפי' העבד שוה שלשים לא פחות ולא יותר — מכל מקום הוי קנס, ואי מודה ביה מיפטר:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 24a:10:2.english: "It is only now that they are testifying against me" - This is astonishing to the Ri, for in any case it should not be [considered] a fine, even according to the one who says (above, Bava Kamma 15a) [that] half-damages is a fine, since once it has gored three times it has left the presumption of being guarded. And it appears [possible] to resolve [this], that half-damages is not divided [into different categories]; since it is a fine in one place, it is a fine in all places, just as we find regarding the thirty [shekels] of a slave, where even if the slave is worth thirty [shekels], neither less nor more — it is nevertheless a fine, and if [the owner] admits to it, he is exempt.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 24a:11:1.hebrew: בפני ב"ד - זהו מסברא, דמי יקבל עדות אם לא בפני בית דין:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 24a:11:1.english: "In the presence of a court" - This is [known] from logical reasoning, for who would accept testimony if not in the presence of a court?

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 24a:12:1.hebrew: הרי כאן שלש עדיות - לענין שלש אחין, ואחד מן השוק מצטרף עמהן:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 24a:12:1.english: There are three testimonies here - [This is] with regard to [a case of] three brothers, where one [unrelated person] from the marketplace joins with [each of] them.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 24a:2:1.hebrew: הרי הוא אומר וזאת - ואם תאמר: כל שכן השתא דאיכא למימר "תוכיח", דמיעט קרא בהדיא? וי"ל דה"ק: דהתם גלי קרא דלא שייכא התם סברא של קירוב וריחוק, שאין שם הטעם תלוי משום דמוחזקת בכך רואה, אלא דגזירת הכתוב הוא דבשלשה ימים היא זבה, אפי' אם יבא אליהו ויאמר ודאי לא תראה עוד:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 24a:2:1.english: "He says: 'And this...'" - And if you say: All the more so now, one can say "[the case of a zava] proves [our point]," since the verse explicitly excluded [her from being determined by sightings]? One can answer that this is what [Rabbi Meir] is saying: There, the verse revealed that the reasoning of proximity and distance [between sightings] does not apply there, for the reason there does not depend on her being established thereby as one who sees [blood]; rather, it is a scriptural decree that in three days she becomes a zava, even if Elijah were to come and say [that] she will certainly not see [blood] anymore.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 24a:3:1.hebrew: ודלמא למעוטי זב מימים - ולא בעי למימר אבל לא זבה מראיות, דאם כן לשתוק מוזאת; אי נמי, המקשה סמך אהיקישא, וכדפריך בסמוך "מה ראית":
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 24a:3:1.english: And perhaps [it comes] to exclude a zav from days - And [the Gemara] does not mean to say "but not a zava from sightings," for if so, let [the verse] be silent from [writing] "and this"; alternatively, the questioner relied on the juxtaposition, and [his question is] just as [the Gemara] asks immediately below: "What did you see?"

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 24a:5:1.hebrew: קאי בראיות ממעט ראיות - תימה: אדרבה, קאי בזב — ממעט זב; קאי בזב — ממעט זבה?! כדדרשינן בפ"ק דשחיטת חולין (דף כד. ושם) ... ' שאין הלוים פסולים במומים, דכתיב: "וזאת אשר ללוים" — ואין אחרת ללוים. ויש לומר, דהתם נמי הוה דרשינן "וזאת ללוים ולא לכהנים", שאין שנים פוסלין בכהנים, אלא משום דדרשינן ליה מ"אשר ללוים":
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 24a:5:1.english: [When it] deals with sightings, it excludes sightings - This is astonishing: on the contrary, [when the verse] deals with a zav, it should exclude a zav; [when it] deals with a zav, does it exclude a zavah?! Just as we expound in the first chapter of Shechitat Chullin (24a, and there) [...] that Levites are not disqualified by blemishes, as it is written: "And this is that which belongs to the Levites" — [meaning "this" applies to the Levites,] and nothing else applies to the Levites. And one can say that there too we would have expounded "and this [belongs] to the Levites, and not to the Kohanim" — that years [of age] do not disqualify Kohanim — were it not that we expound it from "which belongs to the Levites":

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 24a:8:1.hebrew: אנא כרבי יוסי ס"ל - והא דלא קאמר הלכה כרבי יוסי, משום דניחא ליה למנקט תנאי דמתניתין:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 24a:8:1.english: "I hold in accordance with Rabbi Yosei" - And the reason [Rav Nachman] did not say [earlier], "The halakha is in accordance with Rabbi Yosei," is because he preferred to cite the Tannaim of the Mishnah.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 24a:9:1.hebrew: אי לייעודי גברא - לא שיהא מועד לעבור בהתראות, דאם כן לא היה מתחייב עד נגיחה של חמישית נ"ש; אלא לייעודי — שיודיעו בכל פעם שנגח שורו וישמרנו:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 24a:9:1.english: Or to forewarn the man - [This does] not [mean] that he becomes forewarned by undergoing [repeated] warnings, for if so, he would not become liable for full damages until the fifth goring; rather, [it means] to forewarn [him] — that they inform [him] each time his ox has gored, so that he will guard it.
